From 48774e87bbaa0056819d4b52301e4692e50e3252 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Maxime Chevallier <maxime.chevallier@bootlin.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:28:15 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: phy: clean the sfp upstream if phy probing fails

Sashiko reported that we don't call sfp_bus_del_upstream() in the probe
failure path, so let's add it, otherwise the sfp-bus is left with a
dangling 'upstream' field, that may be used later on during SFP events.

This issue existed before the generic phylib sfp support, back when
drivers were calling phy_sfp_probe themselves.

Reviewed-by: Nicolai Buchwitz <nb@tipi-net.de>
Fixes: 298e54fa810e ("net: phy: add core phylib sfp support")
Signed-off-by: Maxime Chevallier <maxime.chevallier@bootlin.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260604092819.723505-2-maxime.chevallier@bootlin.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/phy/phy_device.c b/drivers/net/phy/phy_device.c
index 3370eb822017..6ccbfacf7d1d 100644
--- a/drivers/net/phy/phy_device.c
+++ b/drivers/net/phy/phy_device.c
@@ -1718,6 +1718,9 @@ static int phy_sfp_probe(struct phy_device *phydev)
 
 		ret = sfp_bus_add_upstream(bus, phydev, &sfp_phydev_ops);
 		sfp_bus_put(bus);
+
+		if (ret)
+			phydev->sfp_bus = NULL;
 	}
 
 	if (!ret && phydev->sfp_bus)
@@ -3775,6 +3778,9 @@ static int phy_probe(struct device *dev)
 	return 0;
 
 out:
+	sfp_bus_del_upstream(phydev->sfp_bus);
+	phydev->sfp_bus = NULL;
+
 	if (!phydev->is_on_sfp_module)
 		phy_led_triggers_unregister(phydev);
 
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File Modified: `drivers/net/phy/phy_device.c`

Two changes were made in the same file to ensure proper cleanup of the SFP upstream bus when PHY probing fails:

1. **In `phy_sfp_probe()` (line ~1721):**  
   After calling `sfp_bus_add_upstream()`, if the call fails, the patch sets `phydev->sfp_bus = NULL`. This prevents the PHY device from retaining a dangling reference to an SFP bus that was not successfully attached.

2. **In `phy_probe()` (line ~3781):**  
   In the failure path (`out:` label), two cleanup steps are added:
   - `sfp_bus_del_upstream(phydev->sfp_bus)` ensures the SFP bus no longer regards this PHY as its upstream, avoiding later misuse during SFP events.
   - `phydev->sfp_bus = NULL` clears the reference so no stale pointer remains.

### Relationships Between Modifications

Both modifications address the same root cause: leaving the `sfp_bus` upstream field dangling when PHY probing fails.  

- The fix in `phy_sfp_probe()` covers the case where the upstream addition itself fails, ensuring the bus pointer is cleared immediately.  
- The fix in `phy_probe()` covers the general failure path after a successful upstream addition, ensuring the upstream relationship is properly removed before returning failure.  

Together, these changes ensure that any failure in the PHY probe sequence results in a clean state for the SFP bus, preventing potential use-after-free or incorrect references during future SFP events.
